apps.localizedDescription:
MuffinEMU is a Wii U emulator for iPhone and iPad, iOS 15 and later, built on Cemu: PowerPC interpreters, an AArch64 recompiler, Cafe OS HLE and a native Metal renderer under a SwiftUI app with a measured Wii U GamePad layout. Some MeloCafe cores and bug fixes have been brought over to MuffinEMU.

This source serves the NIGHTLY build - the newest code, rebuilt on every change and tested by nobody. It shares its bundle identifier with the standard build, so installing it replaces a standard install and keeps your games, saves and settings; the two do not sit side by side. Add this source only if you want the newest build rather than the one known to work.

Bring your own games and keys. No copyrighted content is distributed here.

versions.localizedDescription:
The newest build of MuffinEMU, from commit 3dd15c642c86b68a99b81c9278ce51fe5f1cfdb9 on `main`.

This tag moves. It is replaced by every successful build, so the download
here is always the newest code and never a version you can come back to -
for that, use a numbered release.

Untested by anyone. A numbered release has at least been installed and run;
this has only been compiled. If you want the version that works, not the
version that is newest, install the latest numbered release instead.
